# Vantly

> Everyday tools for everyone.

Free file tools that run entirely in the visitor's browser. Files are never
uploaded, so there is no account, no watermark, no file size limit, and no
cap on how many conversions can be done. This is possible because the work
costs the operator nothing: the browser does the decoding and encoding.

## What works today

- [SVG to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/svg-to-png): Convert SVG to PNG at any size, including 4K and 8K, with transparency. No resolution cap, no watermark, and the file stays on your machine.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/heic-to-jpg): Convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG or WebP. Bulk conversion, no file limit. Runs in your browser.
- [Image compressor](https://vantly.xyz/image-compressor): Reduce JPG, PNG and WebP file sizes in your browser. Compare before and after, choose your own quality, convert in bulk. No upload, no watermark, no limit.
- [Image resizer](https://vantly.xyz/image-resizer): Resize images to any longest edge in your browser. Batch resize, aspect ratio always kept, never enlarged, export as JPG, PNG or WebP. No upload and no limit.
- [Merge PDF](https://vantly.xyz/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into a single file. Drag to reorder and remove the pages you do not want.
- [Split PDF](https://vantly.xyz/split-pdf): Split a PDF into separate files or extract a page range. Runs in your browser.
- [Images to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/images-to-pdf): Combine JPG, PNG and HEIC images into one PDF. Reorder them and choose the page size.
- [DOCX viewer](https://vantly.xyz/docx-viewer): View Word documents in your browser. No Office licence. Formatting, tables and images are kept.
- [PPTX viewer](https://vantly.xyz/pptx-viewer): View PowerPoint presentations in your browser. Step through the slides and read the notes.
- [XLSX viewer](https://vantly.xyz/xlsx-viewer): View Excel spreadsheets in your browser. Every sheet, every row, sorted and filtered.
- [PDF viewer](https://vantly.xyz/pdf-viewer): View a PDF in your browser. Step through it a page at a time or scroll the whole document. Nothing is uploaded.
- [CSV viewer](https://vantly.xyz/csv-viewer): View, sort and filter CSV files too large for a spreadsheet. Handles hundreds of thousands of rows in your browser, with no row limit.
- [CSV to JSON](https://vantly.xyz/csv-to-json): Convert CSV to JSON or JSON to CSV in your browser. Choose the delimiter and handle quoted fields.
- [URL encoder](https://vantly.xyz/url-encoder): Percent-encode and decode URLs and query strings, with the component and full-URL rules handled separately.
- [Markdown preview](https://vantly.xyz/markdown-preview): Write markdown with a live preview and export the result as HTML. Runs in your browser with nothing stored.
- [JSON formatter](https://vantly.xyz/json-formatter): Format, minify and validate JSON in your browser. Points at the exact position of a syntax error rather than only saying it is invalid.
- [XML formatter](https://vantly.xyz/xml-formatter): Format, indent and validate XML in your browser.
- [HTML formatter](https://vantly.xyz/html-formatter): Indent and clean HTML in your browser, or minify it back down.
- [CSS formatter](https://vantly.xyz/css-formatter): Tidy CSS for reading or strip it down for shipping, in your browser.
- [JavaScript formatter](https://vantly.xyz/js-formatter): Indent JavaScript for reading or minify it for shipping. Runs in your browser.
- [Regex tester](https://vantly.xyz/regex-tester): Build regular expressions with live highlighting, capture groups and a plain English explanation of what each part does.
- [Diff checker](https://vantly.xyz/diff-checker): Find what changed between two pieces of text or code, highlighted line by line and word by word.
- [Case converter](https://vantly.xyz/case-converter): Switch text between uppercase, lowercase, title case, sentence case, camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and a URL slug.
- [Word counter](https://vantly.xyz/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs as you type, with an estimated reading time.
- [Lorem ipsum generator](https://vantly.xyz/lorem-ipsum-generator): Generate placeholder text by words, sentences or paragraphs, as plain text or wrapped in HTML.
- [Remove empty lines](https://vantly.xyz/remove-empty-lines): Delete blank and whitespace-only lines from any list or block of text. Paste it in, get it back clean. Runs in your browser.
- [Remove duplicate lines](https://vantly.xyz/remove-duplicate-lines): Delete repeated lines from a list, keeping the first of each and the original order. Paste it in and copy the result.
- [Sort lines](https://vantly.xyz/sort-lines): Sort any list of lines A to Z or Z to A, reverse the order, or remove duplicates while you are there.
- [Strip HTML tags](https://vantly.xyz/strip-html-tags): Remove every HTML tag and return just the readable text. Script and style contents go too, and entities are decoded.
- [Hash generator](https://vantly.xyz/hash-generator): Hash text or a file using the cryptography built into your browser. Nothing is uploaded, which matters more here than anywhere else on the site.
- [Password generator](https://vantly.xyz/password-generator): Create random passwords with real cryptographic randomness rather than Math.random. Set the length and character types, and see an honest strength estimate.
- [Base64 encoder](https://vantly.xyz/base64-encoder): Convert text or a file to Base64 and back, including data URIs. Runs in your browser.
- [Unit converter](https://vantly.xyz/unit-converter): Convert between metric and imperial units for length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed and digital storage.
- [Percentage calculator](https://vantly.xyz/percentage-calculator): Work out what percent of a number, what percentage one number is of another, and percentage increase or decrease.
- [Tip and bill splitter](https://vantly.xyz/tip-calculator): Add a tip, split a bill between any number of people, and round the result sensibly.
- [Compound interest](https://vantly.xyz/compound-interest-calculator): Project savings growth over time with regular contributions, showing the total, the contributions and the interest separately.
- [Loan calculator](https://vantly.xyz/loan-calculator): Work out monthly repayments, total interest and a full amortisation schedule for a loan or a mortgage.
- [Date calculator](https://vantly.xyz/date-calculator): Count the days, weeks or months between two dates, or add and subtract time from a date.
- [UUID generator](https://vantly.xyz/uuid-generator): Generate cryptographically random UUIDs one at a time or in bulk, ready to copy.
- [Random picker](https://vantly.xyz/random-picker): Paste a list and pick one at random, or shuffle the whole thing. Uses real randomness rather than Math.random.
- [Colour palette](https://vantly.xyz/color-palette): Extract a colour palette from any image, or build harmonies and shades from one colour. Copy the result as hex, CSS variables, Tailwind, SCSS or JSON.
- [HEX to RGB](https://vantly.xyz/hex-to-rgb): Paste a hex colour like #b4530a and get the RGB values, plus HSL and CMYK. Runs in your browser.
- [RGB to HEX](https://vantly.xyz/rgb-to-hex): Paste RGB values and get the hex code, plus HSL and CMYK. Runs in your browser.
- [HEX to HSL](https://vantly.xyz/hex-to-hsl): Paste a hex colour and get HSL, the format worth learning because lightness is one number. Runs in your browser.
- [HSL to HEX](https://vantly.xyz/hsl-to-hex): Paste HSL values and get the hex code, plus RGB and CMYK. Runs in your browser.
- [RGB to HSL](https://vantly.xyz/rgb-to-hsl): Paste RGB values and get HSL, which makes a colour easier to adjust. Runs in your browser.
- [HSL to RGB](https://vantly.xyz/hsl-to-rgb): Paste HSL values and get RGB, plus hex and CMYK. Runs in your browser.
- [RGB to CMYK](https://vantly.xyz/rgb-to-cmyk): Paste RGB values and get an approximate CMYK breakdown for print. Runs in your browser.
- [CMYK to RGB](https://vantly.xyz/cmyk-to-rgb): Paste CMYK values and get RGB and hex for screen use. Runs in your browser.
- [HEX to CMYK](https://vantly.xyz/hex-to-cmyk): Paste a hex colour and get an approximate CMYK breakdown for print. Runs in your browser.
- [Colour picker](https://vantly.xyz/color-picker): Pick a colour and read it back as hex, RGB, HSL and CMYK. Runs in your browser.
- [Contrast checker](https://vantly.xyz/contrast-checker): Check whether a text and background pair meets WCAG AA or AAA, with the ratio and a live preview.
- [UTM link builder](https://vantly.xyz/utm-builder): Build Google Analytics campaign URLs with the right parameter names, and keep a list of the ones you have made.
- [Robots.txt generator](https://vantly.xyz/robots-txt-generator): Build a robots.txt with the rules you actually want, including whether AI crawlers are allowed.
- [Meta tag generator](https://vantly.xyz/meta-tag-generator): Write the meta and Open Graph tags for a page and see how the result looks as a search result and as a shared card.
- [PDF to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/pdf-to-png): Turn each page of a PDF into a PNG at the resolution you choose. Pick every page or a range.
- [PDF to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/pdf-to-jpg): Turn each page of a PDF into a JPG. Choose the pages and the resolution.
- [PDF to text](https://vantly.xyz/pdf-to-txt): Pull the plain text out of a PDF, without the formatting, images or layout.
- [Word to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/word-to-pdf): Turn a Word document into a PDF, so the formatting holds on any machine.
- [Excel to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/excel-to-pdf): Turn a spreadsheet into a PDF, choosing which sheets and how the columns fit the page.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/pptx-to-pdf): Turn a PPTX into a PDF, one page per slide, with the notes kept or dropped.
- [HTML to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/html-to-pdf): Turn HTML into a PDF with the page size and margins you choose.
- [EPUB to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/epub-to-pdf): Turn an EPUB into a PDF at a fixed page size, for printing or for a device that cannot read EPUB.
- [PNG to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/png-to-pdf): Combine PNG images into a single PDF, in the order you choose.
- [JPG to PDF](https://vantly.xyz/jpg-to-pdf): Combine JPG photos or scans into a single PDF, reordered however you like.
- [PDF converter](https://vantly.xyz/pdf-converter): Convert to and from PDF: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, EPUB, images and plain text.
- [Watermark a PDF](https://vantly.xyz/watermark-pdf): Add text or an image across the pages of a PDF, angled and faded how you choose.
- [Unlock PDF](https://vantly.xyz/unlock-pdf): Take the password off a PDF you can already open, so it stops asking every time.
- [JPG to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/jpg-to-png): Convert a JPEG photo to PNG in the browser, in bulk.
- [JPG to WebP](https://vantly.xyz/jpg-to-webp): Convert a JPEG photo to WebP in the browser, in bulk.
- [PNG to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/png-to-jpg): Convert a PNG image to JPG in the browser, in bulk.
- [PNG to WebP](https://vantly.xyz/png-to-webp): Convert a PNG image to WebP in the browser, in bulk.
- [WebP to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/webp-to-jpg): Convert a WebP image to JPG in the browser, in bulk.
- [WebP to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/webp-to-png): Convert a WebP image to PNG in the browser, in bulk.
- [AVIF to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/avif-to-jpg): Convert an AVIF image to JPG in the browser, in bulk.
- [AVIF to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/avif-to-png): Convert an AVIF image to PNG in the browser, in bulk.
- [AVIF to WebP](https://vantly.xyz/avif-to-webp): Convert an AVIF image to WebP in the browser, in bulk.
- [GIF to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/gif-to-jpg): Convert a GIF image to JPG in the browser, in bulk.
- [GIF to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/gif-to-png): Convert a GIF image to PNG in the browser, in bulk.
- [GIF to WebP](https://vantly.xyz/gif-to-webp): Convert a GIF image to WebP in the browser, in bulk.
- [BMP to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/bmp-to-jpg): Convert a bitmap image to JPG in the browser, in bulk.
- [BMP to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/bmp-to-png): Convert a bitmap image to PNG in the browser, in bulk.
- [BMP to WebP](https://vantly.xyz/bmp-to-webp): Convert a bitmap image to WebP in the browser, in bulk.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://vantly.xyz/heic-to-jpg): Convert an iPhone HEIC photo to JPG in the browser, in bulk.
- [HEIC to WebP](https://vantly.xyz/heic-to-webp): Convert an iPhone HEIC photo to WebP in the browser, in bulk.
- [SVG to PNG](https://vantly.xyz/svg-to-png): Convert an SVG vector to PNG in the browser, in bulk.

## Known limits

- Image encoding is limited to PNG, JPEG and WebP, because those are the only
  formats a browser canvas can write. AVIF, BMP and TIFF can be read but not
  yet written.
- Only the first frame of an animated GIF is converted.
- Images are never enlarged when resizing, since scaling up cannot add detail
  that was not captured.
- PDF, Office and audio or video conversion are planned but not built. Pages
  exist for them and say so.
